analytical_question: Where can Asterion displace NovaGrid within the next 12 months?
action_title: Asterion threatens retrofit fleets now, but lacks the certification path to win OEM platforms
executive_answer: Treat Asterion as a channel-or-contain decision in aftermarket while preserving certification-led differentiation in OEM pursuits.

evidence_blocks.claim: Asterion has field deployments in retrofit fleets.
Asterion states its module is production-ready.
No primary evidence of full OEM homologation was found.

logic.mechanism: Field access drives near-term retrofit advantage; homologation gates constrain OEM conversion.

counterargument: Asterion could close the certification gap through a Tier-1 partnership.
falsifier: Verified OEM nomination or homologation filing moves OEM threat from medium to high.
implication: Open a bounded module-supply discussion while accelerating the certification evidence package.
decision: Partner-test in retrofit; defend in OEM.
trigger: Technical exchange completed and homologation status verified within 30 days.
speaker_notes: All names and evidence IDs are synthetic. In a live deck, include full citations and qualification language.
